Relations are DISC-002 certificates (exhaustive verification on the rows, FND-007 snapshots). Each reconstruction is the normal form under a lex order with the eliminated columns first (GEOM-001), its certificate derived and checked by FND-007, and it is kept only when its row check (values, NULL mask, range) holds. Costs are relative work units of the bit-plane engine from the actual bit widths measured on every row, not time; DuckDB times the same forms as the baseline.
CUDA (tr_mgpu_elim_check) is timed only with --device; emulated runs are compared with the CPU in tests/test_math_elim.py, never timed as CUDA.
